purpose: Convert the current propulsion benchmark set into an electrical stress-test envelope for architecture work without freezing product requirements.

commercial_reference_envelope.derived_current_note: 4640 W / 69 V arithmetic only. This is not the custom ESC continuous current requirement and is not phase current.

semiconductor_voltage_class_screen.reason: Only 19 V static headroom remains before switching overshoot, battery tolerance, wiring inductance and regenerative transients are considered.
Provides 39 V static headroom to the 81 V commercial reference. Final acceptance still requires measured/derived transient ceiling and derating evidence.
Provides the largest static voltage headroom of the screened classes, with the expected conduction/switching/package trade still unresolved.

current_domain_rules.rule: No phase or switch current may be derived directly from the commercial DC bus current without motor operating point, modulation index, power factor, torque demand and control waveform evidence.

speed_domain_rules.mechanical_rpm_note: 45 rpm/V x 81 V is a linear no-load screening number only, not a loaded propeller operating point.
speed_domain_rules.rule: eRPM remains OPEN until exact motor pole count and loaded speed data are selected.

architecture_implications.100v_power_stage: Do not use as the primary 80 V-class design path unless the final battery/transient envelope later proves substantially lower and switching overshoot is evidenced.
architecture_implications.120v_power_stage: Continue loss, package, gate-drive and transient analysis.
architecture_implications.150v_power_stage: Continue loss, package, gate-drive and transient analysis as the higher-headroom path.
architecture_implications.auxiliary_supply: Any legacy 100 V-input auxiliary converter remains REVALIDATE until the final VBUS transient ceiling is known.
architecture_implications.dc_link: Capacitor voltage, capacitance, ESR/ripple and precharge values remain OPEN.
architecture_implications.gate_driver: Driver voltage domain, gate current and isolation/bootstrap architecture remain OPEN until power-switch class and PWM/transient requirements close.

next_calculations: normalize 120 V and 150 V MOSFET loss comparison at common current/PWM/temperature assumptions
screen gate-driver voltage-domain compatibility for both carried-forward classes
build DC-link transient/precharge bounding model using trade-only 80 V-class bus
derive phase-current envelope only after a motor/prop operating point is selected
anti_hallucination_rule: This file may narrow architecture work but must not promote VBUS, current, PWM, MOSFET class, device count or phase current into G1/G2 baseline requirements.
